atoms.b: This is a diagram of an eye. The ((++iris pupil)) is the colourful ring in the eye. Each one is unique, and they can come in many colours like brown, green, grey and blue. This is the muscle that controls the size of the pupil.

The black circle in the eye is called the ((++pupil eyelash)). This is the part of the eye that lets in light so that we can see. It can change size depending on how much light there is. It gets smaller when there is a lot of light and larger when there is not a lot of light.
Eyes have hairs that protect them. These are called ((++eyelashes the_iris)). They catch small particles like dust and sand.
